challenges.title: G4.3 measures silent mis-merges in the one population where they almost cannot occur
The line-based silent-mis-merge baseline that G4.3 compares against is approximately zero by construction
The seven-noun constraint is violated by the spec's own CLI table
`ltx verify` is undefined on a partial clone, which is the v1 default
Every latency gate assumes the daemon, and no gate measures life without it
"Audit-grade provenance" is a stronger claim than the threat model can support
Redaction under sync is a censorship and denial-of-service vector, and no gate tests it adversarially
"Universal undo" cannot mean what a user will assume it means for `sync`
G1.9(b)'s 1.5× bar against `git gc --aggressive` on source text is the likeliest gate to fail, and CDC is the reason
§0.9's "independent instances" are not independent in the way the gate needs
§0.9 lets a HARD gate be downgraded on the agent's own say-so
"every state-changing command is undoable" is false for redaction and thinning, and must be
the operation log grows without bound and nothing in the spec stops it
§0.5's plateau formula grants a waiver to a gate that is actively getting worse
"deleting every lens loses zero information" is not true as stated
no gate checks that Lattice may legally ship
